name: soulver
title: Soulver
description: Leverage the Soulver CLI to solve expressions and manage your Soulver sheetbooks using Raycast and Raycast AI.
author: bitforger

commands.name: soulver
commands.title: Solve Expression
commands.subtitle: Soulver CLI
commands.description: Runs Soulver CLI to evaluate passed expression or clipboard contents

tools.name: solve
tools.title: Solve Expression
tools.description: Evaluates a mathematical, financial, unit conversion, or natural language calculation expression using Soulver CLI.

tools.name: list-sheets
tools.title: List Soulver Sheets
tools.description: Lists all sheets in the active Soulver sheetbook.

tools.name: create-sheet
tools.title: Create Soulver Sheet
tools.description: Creates a new sheet in the Soulver sheetbook.

tools.name: delete-sheet
tools.title: Delete Soulver Sheet
tools.description: Deletes a sheet from the Soulver sheetbook.

tools.name: duplicate-sheet
tools.title: Duplicate Soulver Sheet
tools.description: Duplicates an existing sheet in the Soulver sheetbook.

tools.name: move-sheet
tools.title: Move Soulver Sheet
tools.description: Moves a sheet into a specified folder in the Soulver sheetbook.

tools.name: pin-sheet
tools.title: Pin Soulver Sheet
tools.description: Pins or toggles pin status of a sheet in the Soulver sheetbook.

tools.name: archive-sheet
tools.title: Archive Soulver Sheet
tools.description: Archives a sheet in the Soulver sheetbook.

tools.name: read-sheet
tools.title: Read Soulver Sheet
tools.description: Reads all lines and evaluated answers from a specific Soulver sheet.

tools.name: append-line
tools.title: Append Line to Soulver Sheet
tools.description: Appends a new line or calculation expression to a specified Soulver sheet.

tools.name: insert-line
tools.title: Insert Line into Soulver Sheet
tools.description: Inserts a new line or calculation at a specific 1-based index in a Soulver sheet.

tools.name: update-line
tools.title: Update Soulver Sheet Line
tools.description: Updates an existing line content in a Soulver sheet.

tools.name: delete-line
tools.title: Delete Soulver Sheet Line
tools.description: Deletes a line from a Soulver sheet by its 1-based line number.

tools.name: mark-line
tools.title: Mark Soulver Sheet Line
tools.description: Marks a line behavior in a Soulver sheet (e.g. subtotal, running-total, running-budget, timepoint, expression).

tools.name: inspect-line
tools.title: Inspect Soulver Line
tools.description: Inspects structured JSON metadata of a specific line in a Soulver sheet.

tools.name: search-sheets
tools.title: Search Soulver Sheets
tools.description: Searches for text, numbers, or expressions across Soulver sheets.

tools.name: manage-variables
tools.title: Manage Soulver Global Variables
tools.description: Lists, sets, or deletes global variables in the Soulver sheetbook.

tools.name: manage-definitions
tools.title: Manage Soulver Custom Definitions
tools.description: Shows or appends custom definitions and unit rules in Soulver.

tools.name: export-sheet
tools.title: Export Soulver Sheet
tools.description: Exports a Soulver sheet to TXT, CSV, HTML, or PNG format or copies it to the clipboard.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
